observer_report.scope: Collection parent and observed descendants, including initialization and teardown.
observer_report.limitation: Sampling can miss short-lived processes and CPU before a child's first sample; RSS can double-count shared pages. After observer failure the unsampled interval is a coverage gap, not proof of a CPU breach or continuous successful enforcement. Call check_health before each real reset/step.

child_command_scope: Harmless Python process imports psutil/json, prints inherited affinity, waits for one newline, then exits. No ViZDoom SDK or simulator call.
